title: DoppeL.ink
tagline: Wallet that allows high-performance AI real-time voice changers to be rented on a pay-as-you-go basis or bought and sold as NFTs
description:
AI Voice Changer Wallet.
It has a built-in AI voice changer called RVC, which can provide your voice using your own speech and songs as training data.
It is available with pay-as-you-go billing using SuperFluid, or as NFT, which allows users to sell out of the system.
Users are charged only for what they want to use, which is highly satisfactory.
